direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for the stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular alignment for quantities, time and cost
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo at left and Lock recovery room at right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the logo inside the right inspector; keep only the header placement here and the opening-story placement, replacing the inspector logo with a MATERIAL HOLD / RECOVERY MISSION text label.
Enlarge the 120 versus 80 tracks and DOES NOT MATCH label, align their right edges on one axis, and make each track keyboard-focusable with inspector highlighting.
Compress lower option chips and event chain by 12px so all stage content fits 1366x768 without crowding the legend.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT for nonce and identity and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate headed regions with separate status text, controls, and focus order; do not merge their actions.
Add a visible 2px neon focus ring to the investigation-route select and label its offline state in text, not colour alone.
Shorten the bottom explanatory panel to one sentence so the primary Run Sample investigation action remains unmistakably singular.
Keep the typed consent form visible after selecting a recovery option, tie the exact APPROVE phrase, plan identifier, and disabled Accept state together with aria-describedby.
Refit the three comparison cards to equal heights with right-aligned tabular 83h, 35h, 17.5h and cost values at 360px width.
Enlarge Select this path targets to at least 36px and show selection by marker, border pattern, and text.
Preserve PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on all three tasks in both the board header and DecisionBar status until Approve is activated.
Make the neon recovery route through CELL-MILL-1 only, label 40 via CELL-MILL-1 and 30 via CELL-MILL-1 without implying flow through any other cell.
Reduce task-card vertical padding so t1, t2, t3, End of proposal, and Decline proposal fit without relying on a thin internal scrollbar.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 in silver dashed PREVIEW - WILL GO OFFLINE before Apply; reserve full red outline, cross-hatch, and OFFLINE-STOPPED only for the actual stopped state.
State the invalidation consequence once beside the machine select and once in the DecisionBar, using identical wording.
Enlarge the machine select to 40px height with a visible focus ring and retain CELL-MILL-1 ONLINE capacity as non-interactive comparison text.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 red only on outline, cross-hatch, and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; remove any red fill glow and keep its interior black and silver.
Retain the separate pre-flight route-health region and distinct investigation evidence region exactly as in step 2, with Reinvestigate recovery acting only on the evidence task.
Align the CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE - 3 to 2 feasible paths banner with the Certificate and Receiving tracks so the capacity change reads in one scan.
Keep CONSTRAINED Split available capacity visibly infeasible with hatch pattern, reason text, and no selectable radio control.
Keep the typed consent form tied to the revised plan, show prior acceptance invalidated in the DecisionBar, and keep Accept disabled until the exact phrase matches.
Enlarge the phrase input to 44px, show typed count and match state in text, and preserve the neon focus ring at all times.
Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks and 3 PROPOSED untracked replacement tasks simultaneously visible, clearly separated, beside the approved revised plan status.
Ensure the neon route uses CELL-MILL-1 only and never crosses the red stopped CELL-MILL-2; add OFFLINE-STOPPED to the legend state shown on the node.
Refit the board scroll region so t3 is fully visible before scrolling and the Approve revised tasks primary stays fixed in the DecisionBar.
Sequence Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet, and Retain independent checkpoint as numbered disabled-until-ready controls with text completion states.
Enlarge the passphrase field to 44px, state 16-160 characters and three word or character types beside it, and announce readiness through aria-live polite.
Align 70 parts at stake, 35h accepted plan, and 48h versus replenishment as three tabular metrics with one shared baseline.

Add the opening-story logo placement only if this complete screen is the opening story; otherwise keep this screen logo-free beyond the header and never add a third placement in the inspector or stage.
Remove the duplicate Verify ledger primary from the DecisionBar area by keeping Back and the PACKET SEALED status only, since all three proof actions already show Complete in the inspector.
Increase contrast of the sealed-status line and give Recovery story complete an aria-current marker in the rail with a 36px target.
